title: Heko's Pearl Dispenser
description: Shoots Ender Pearls from dispensers instead of simply dropping the item.
body:
## **Shoots Ender Pearls from dispensers instead of simply dropping the item.**

**How to use:**
Place a Dragon Head on top of the dispenser, put Ender Pearls inside it, and activate it with redstone. The dispenser will launch the Ender Pearl normally.
![Showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2163eafb76d96d0b9c4dc5f1edd07363d5c9429b.gif)
Dragon Head -> Player who placed the head will own the pearl
Player Head -> Player associated with the head will own the pearl

a port plugin inspired by:
[Pearl Dispenser Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/pearl-dispenser)
